description: FarmVibes.AI is Microsoft's Python and workflow software for combining agricultural observations with machine-learning and process calculations. Its local cluster exposes a REST API and Python client, with operations for satellite imagery, weather, terrain and time-series analysis. Users select areas, periods and workflows; results include imagery products, crop estimates, harvest-period indicators and microclimate forecasts. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the selected source data. Public source and installation documentation are free under MIT, with optional Azure deployment. A limitation is that deployment needs the documented container environment, while external APIs and datasets retain their own access requirements. The carbon example calls a separate COMET-Farm service. FarmVibes.AI can prepare agricultural production and weather inputs for food-supply and irrigation simulations, complementing the subnational yield benchmark CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). The repository supplies reusable operations, workflow definitions and explanatory notebooks. These are software examples, not verified regional forecasts. No cluster, cloud account or input dataset was installed or accessed.
